::: {#def-data-set}

#### Data set

A **data set** is a finite collection of $\nobs$ labelled observations,
that is, $\nobs$ pairs $(\vpredvar_i, \outvar_i)$, each an input $\vpredvar_i$ with its outcome $\outvar_i$:

$$
\dataset \eqdef \set{(\vpredvar_i, \outvar_i) : i = 1, \ldots, \nobs} .
$$ {#eq-data-set}

:::
